platforms.name: Mesa 24/7
platforms.notes: Most bookable mid-range and many fine-dining rooms; slots readable per date and party.

platforms.name: Own site
platforms.notes: The top tasting menus book on their own sites, often with a prepaid deposit.

config.closures: Many restaurants close Sunday dinner and Monday; cevicherías serve lunch only.
config.release_norms: Tasting menus release tables weeks ahead; cancellations reappear close to the date.
config.card_notes: Prepaid deposits and some bookings ask for a card and a passport or ID number.
config.tipping: About 10% where no service charge is added.
